holds.reason: The indexed chapter does contain Yose and Ḥanina reporting Yishmael in a passage with Yaakov bar Aḥa, but the manuscript-text name there is Yishmael son of Yose. The unusual patronymic in the root entry remains qualified.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
